segments.sn35.6:1.2: Yadanattā taṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
segments.sn35.6:1.3: Saddā … gandhā … rasā … phoṭṭhabbā … dhammā anattā.
segments.sn35.6:1.8: Yadanattā taṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
segments.sn35.6:1.9: Evaṃ passaṃ … pe … nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātī”ti.
